note: West Carroll Parish has no public queryable zoning district layer. The Town of Oak Grove (parish seat) zones its land, but publishes its zoning only as a 2019 PDF zoning map plus ordinance PDFs at townofoakgrove.org/zoning-ordinance. ArcGIS search found only unrelated West Carroll redistricting layers (police jury, school board) and no zoning service. Regrid and Dynamo Spatial sell commercial parcel data with zoning attributes, which is not an official public service.
